# Welcome to the UU Programming Cafe! {data-background-color="#FFCD00"}

::: {.footer}
:::

## Code Along, Feel Empowered

::: {.theme-section}
An informal space for researchers and research supporters to learn from one another and share programming know-how

- Meet people working with code and data across Utrecht University
- Pick up practical ideas and tools
- Bring questions, curiosity, and your laptop

:::

## How the café works

::: {.theme-section}

**15:00 - Theme presentation or demo**  
A short, interactive introduction to a programming topic (usually up to 30 minutes).

**15:30 - Questions, conversation, and snacks**  
Ask questions, discussion, work on exercises.

**16:00 - Community programming**  
Work on your own project, troubleshoot a bug together, or discuss your issues with an engineer.

**17:00 - Wrap-up**

:::

## Next editions

::: {.theme-section}

- 21 January, 15:30
- **University Library in City Center**

**Your input appreciated!**
Have an idea for a future theme or want to present? Get in touch at [info.rdm@uu.nl](mailto:info.rdm@uu.nl).

:::
